# Overview

This analysis is based on a PySCENIC analysis of mouse NASH/NAFLD models done by Jana Hundertmark.  


```{r}
scData <- readRDS(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA", "ZhangIM_and_GutCellAtlas_HealthyAdult_Epi_BBKNN_CC_adjusted.RData"))
meta <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/Zhang_IM_and_intestine_Epi_only_BBKNN_CC_adj_cluster_Metadata.RData")
scData@meta.data <- meta[Cells(scData),]
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
scData$cluster_label = factor(scData$cluster_label, levels=sort(unique(scData$cluster_label)))
scData <- SetIdent(scData, value="cluster_label")
DimPlot(scData, label=T) + NoLegend()
```

colnames(pyscenic_res) = gsub("\\.\\.\\.", "", colnames(pyscenic_res))

# Differential TF activity

## TF as cluster markers, across all conditions

We compute average TF differences between clusters and select those with significant (Wilcoxon/U-test) differences of at least 0.01 activity score units and at least 5% relative difference (scaled. Since the range of those acivity scores (max 0..1) is different for each TF, we also compute a relative difference by dividing through the range of activity across all cells for each TF. 

```{r}
mm = t(scores_ordered)

scData_orig <- scData
scData <- subset(scData, cells = colnames(mm))
scData[["pyscenic"]] = CreateAssayObject(data=mm)

if(rerun_dge_analyses) {
  tf_markers = FindAllMarkers(scData, assay="pyscenic", logfc.threshold = 0.01, min.pct = 0.1 )
  colnames(tf_markers) = gsub("avg_log2FC", "avg_difference", colnames(tf_markers))
  tf_ranges = apply(apply(mm, 1, range), 2, diff)
  tf_markers$avg_diff_relative = tf_markers$avg_difference / tf_ranges[tf_markers$gene]
  
  tf_markers = tf_markers[, c("cluster", "gene",  "avg_difference", "avg_diff_relative", "p_val", "p_val_adj", "pct.1", "pct.2")]
  tf_markers = tf_markers[order(as.character(tf_markers$cluster), -tf_markers$avg_diff_relative), ]
  tf_markers = subset(tf_markers, abs(avg_diff_relative) > 0.05)
  
  writexl::write_xlsx(tf_markers, path=file.path(result_folder, "TF_cluster_markers_across_all.xlsx"))
  saveRDS(tf_markers, file.path(data_storage_folder, "TF_cluster_markers_across_all.rds"))
  
} else {
  tf_markers = readRDS(file.path(data_storage_folder, "TF_cluster_markers_across_all.rds"))
}
```

## Absolute differences

```{r}
plot_top_genes <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(data$cluster_label))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, cluster==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_difference > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)<1) next
    tmp_up$direction = "up"
    tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_difference < 0)
    tmp_down$direction = "down"
    
    #final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = head(tmp_up, 10)
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_difference),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$gene, levels = final_top_genes$gene)
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_difference, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=12) )
    print(p)
    
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
plot_top_genes(scData, tf_markers, "Cluster TF markers")
```

## Comparison between treatment groups

We now compare TF activities between groups in cells belonging to the same clusters in order to identify treatment related TF changes. 

```{r}
compute_DGE <- function(data, target_suffix, control_suffix, group_parameter, min_cells_per_group = 20, sel_celltypes=NULL) {
  all_celltypes = unique(data$cluster_label)
  
  dge_results = list()
  
  cellcounts_per_group = table(data$cluster_label, data@meta.data[[group_parameter]])
  if(is.null(sel_celltypes)) sel_celltypes = rownames(cellcounts_per_group[apply(cellcounts_per_group, 1, min)>min_cells_per_group,])
  
  for (tt in sel_celltypes) {
    tmp = FindMarkers(data , ident.1 = paste0(tt,target_suffix), ident.2 = paste0(tt,control_suffix), verbose = FALSE, assay = "pyscenic", logfc.threshold = 0.01)
    tmp$celltype = tt
    tmp$GeneSymbol = rownames(tmp)
    colnames(tmp) = gsub("avg_log2FC", "avg_difference", colnames(tmp))
    tmp$avg_diff_relative = tmp$avg_difference / tf_ranges[tmp$GeneSymbol]
    dge_results[[tt]] = tmp
  }
  
  return(dge_results)
}

plot_top_genes <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(dge_results_all$celltype))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, celltype==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_difference > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)>0) tmp_up$direction = "Up"
    tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_difference < 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_down)>0) tmp_down$direction = "Down"
    
    final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_difference),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$GeneSymbol, levels = final_top_genes$GeneSymbol)
    cols = hue_pal()(2)
    names(cols) = c("Up","Down")
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_difference, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=14) ) +   scale_fill_manual(values=cols)
    print(p)
    
  }
}

plot_top_genes_rel <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(dge_results_all$celltype))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, celltype==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_diff_relative > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)>0) tmp_up$direction = "Up"
    tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_diff_relative < 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_down)>0) tmp_down$direction = "Down"
    
    final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_diff_relative),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$GeneSymbol, levels = final_top_genes$GeneSymbol)
    cols = hue_pal()(2)
    names(cols) = c("Up","Down")
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_diff_relative, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=14) ) + labs(y="Difference relative to TF activity range")  +   scale_fill_manual(values=cols)
    print(p)
    
  }
}


```

## Selected comparisons

We compare the following cell types: 

  - Intestinal stem cell/stomach vs Intestinal stem cell/gut [ISC_sto_vs_ISC_gut]
  - Intestinal stem cell/stomach vs Sto gland base/stomach [ISC_sto_vs_gland_base_sto]
  - Enterocyte prox/stomach vs Enterocyte (prox)/gut [Enterocyte_prox_sto_vs_gut]
  - Enterocyte DD/stomach vs Enterocyte DD/gut [Enterocyte_DD_sto_vs_gut]
  - Enterocyte prox/stomach vs Sto gland base/stomach [Ent_prox_sto_vs_gland_base_sto]
  - Goblet cell/stomach vs Goblet cell/gut [goblet_sto_vs_gut]
  - Paneth/stomach vs Paneth/gut [paneth_sto_vs_gut]
  - TA_Colonocyte/stomach vs TA_Colonocyte/gut [TA_Colonocyte_sto_vs_gut]
